facts.statement: Tenant reported on 06/04/2026 that the washing machine at Flat 8, 118 Meadow Row, Alderwick, ZZ3 6ZZ is not draining; they had already removed and cleaned the filter and manually drained it.
No hazard is reported: no gas, electrical, water ingress, heating, security or water-supply element, so the case is routine and not an emergency definition.

The sole completion evidence is an untrusted third-person message of 15/04/2026: 'Oliver confirmed that he completed the repair ... on November 4th' — a date that cannot belong to a job raised 06/04/2026 and instructed 13/04/2026.

The landlord was told the 'drain-pipe propeller has been re-fitted and the washing machine re-installed'; no artefact in the history is the source of that description, and the email is addressed to 'Miles Kendall' though the landlord of record is Ava Rowan.
Two different tenant identities and phone numbers were issued to the provider for the same address: Isaac Quinn / 07700 900844 and Grace Ashford / 07700 900641.
Document upload was skipped ('not needed at this time'), landlord confirmation was flagged as still needed, and the request was then marked closed.
No invoice or cost figure for this job appears anywhere in the history.

Re: washing machine not draining — Flat 8, 118 Meadow Row, Alderwick, ZZ3 6ZZ (reported 6 April 2026).

Our record shows appliance contractor Oakfield Homes was instructed on 13 April 2026 to contact you and attend. Before we complete this job we need to confirm the outcome with you directly:

1. Has an engineer attended the flat? If so, on what date?
2. Is the washing machine now draining normally?

If nobody has attended, or it is still not draining, please tell us and we will re-book the visit with you at a time that suits. You do not need to give access to answer this message. Apologies for the delay in coming back to you.
